collection.description: Teenagers are asked to propose fair rules for a shared playground used by younger children.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Teenagers are asked to propose fair rules for a shared playground used by younger children.

choices.label: Try the Rules for One Afternoon

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The children suggest a turn-taking signal adults had overlooked.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The teens learn that the youngest children need a simpler rule than they first drafted.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Caregivers identify a safety issue near the climbing frame.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The teens feel their proposal is being challenged, then distinguish criticism from rejection.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The rules reduce quarrels and earn cautious support.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A confusing rule causes arguments, so the teens revise it publicly.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The teenagers give a thoughtful account of fairness and safety.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (teen), an outspoken teen, dominates; the group asks a quieter member to present the next point.
